items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar due date, 28.12.2026 (a Monday, not a weekend day or public holiday in Bremen), so no shift under §108 Abs. 3 AO is needed. Due date is exactly as printed: 2026-12-28. (A bank transfer should be sent a business day earlier, by 2026-12-23, to arrive in time under §675s BGB.)

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter prints two dates: the document date 'Datum 19.11.2026' and a separate, later posting date 'Abgesandt am 20.11.2026'. §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO measures the deemed-delivery period from the actual day the letter was handed to the post, which the letter itself states as 20.11.2026 (Friday). Deemed delivery is the 4th day after posting (letters posted since 2025): 20.11.2026 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday) — this is also 'today' in this scenario, so the letter is deemed delivered today. Under §108 Abs. 1 AO / §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (24.11.) is not counted; the one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs. 1 AO) then runs from 25.11.2026 and ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the start day of the period, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12.2026 is not a Sunday, Saturday or statutory public holiday in Bremen (Christmas Eve itself is not a gesetzlicher Feiertag), so under §108 Abs. 3 AO the date is not shifted. Due date: 2026-12-24. Note: if the real posting day was in fact 19.11. (matching the printed 'Datum'), the deadline would be one day earlier (2026-12-23); the letter's own 'Abgesandt am' entry is treated as authoritative here.

warnings: The letter shows two different dates for issuance: 'Datum 19.11.2026' and 'Abgesandt am 20.11.2026'; the Einspruch deadline was computed from the stated posting date (20.11.2026) as that is what §122 AO deemed-delivery actually counts from — double-check this against the envelope postmark if you have it.

The letter warns that surcharges ('Zuschläge') accrue for each month payment is late (§240 AO Verspätungszuschlag/Säumniszuschlag) — make sure the 1.624,00 € reaches the tax office's account by 28.12.2026.

The payment IBAN (DE62 2900 0000 0006 6401 00, 'Bremer Landesmusterkasse') is well-formed and consistent with a German state tax-collection account, but an IBAN alone does not prove ownership — compare it with a previous, trusted Finanzamt letter before paying if in doubt.
